_comment: Core numbers of the 11th edition Core Rules — edit here only; the engine reads from this file (section numbers refer to docs/01-rules-11e-reference.md)

coreStratagems.name: Command Re-roll
coreStratagems.short_summary: Re-roll 1 Hit, Wound, Damage or Save roll
coreStratagems.when: Just after an Advance / Charge / Damage / Hazardous / Hit / Save / Wound roll

coreStratagems.name: Epic Challenge
coreStratagems.when: Fight phase, when a CHARACTER unit is selected to fight
coreStratagems.text: 1 CHARACTER gains [PRECISION] on melee weapons until end of phase

coreStratagems.name: Insane Bravery
coreStratagems.text: Automatically pass a Battle-shock test (once per battle)

coreStratagems.name: Explosives
coreStratagems.text: An EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES unit selects a visible enemy within 8", rolls 6D6, each 4+ = 1 mortal wound

coreStratagems.name: Crushing Impact
coreStratagems.short_summary: Roll T dice: 5+ deals Mortal Wounds
coreStratagems.when: Your Charge phase, after a MONSTER/VEHICLE has finished charging
coreStratagems.text: Roll D6 equal to T: each 5+ = 1 mortal wound to an enemy (max 6), each 1 = 1 mortal wound to itself

coreStratagems.name: Rapid Ingress
coreStratagems.short_summary: Arrive from Reserves in opponent's turn
coreStratagems.text: A unit in Reserves makes an Ingress move (not in battle round 1)

coreStratagems.name: Fire Overwatch
coreStratagems.text: An unengaged unit makes Snap Shooting attacks (hits only on 6, range 24")

coreStratagems.name: Smokescreen
coreStratagems.short_summary: Gain Benefit of Cover & Stealth (-1 to Hit)
coreStratagems.when: Start of the opponent's Shooting phase
coreStratagems.text: SMOKE unit gains the Benefit of Cover until end of phase

coreStratagems.name: Heroic Intervention
coreStratagems.short_summary: Charge into combat in opponent's Charge phase
coreStratagems.text: Leap to Defend: charge a unit that just charged / Into the Fray (+1CP): charge roll max 6, any target within 6"

coreStratagems.name: Counteroffensive
coreStratagems.short_summary: Gain Fights First and fight immediately
coreStratagems.when: Opponent's Fight step, after an enemy unit has fought
coreStratagems.text: Our unit gains Fights First and fights next
